changes: Enemy map circles stay small and no longer grow. Several enemies seen in one place share a circle with their number in the middle and their icons around the edge.
An enemy you can see only by its nameplate is no longer placed next to you: one of your spells must be in range.
WoW Forever: the starting graveyards share one resurrection clock, and a captured base's graveyard keeps its own. In Arathi Basin, dying at your start names Alliance start or Horde start.
Cyrillic and Asian player names no longer show as boxes, and enemy rows no longer repeat a spec as text beside its icon.
